meaning:
A. Compar., πρότερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX for רִאשׁוֹן ,לִפָנִים, etc. ;]
before, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, before, former: Eph.4:22. Adverbially, πρότερον, before, aforetime, formerly: Jhn.7:50, 2Co.1:15, Heb.4:6; opposite to ἔπειτα, Heb.7:27; τὸ π., Jhn.6:62 9:8, Gal.4:13, 1Ti.1:13; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, Heb.10:32; αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, 1Pe.1:14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
